title: [Bug]: Gemma4 tool parser (non-streaming): finish_reason=tool_calls with empty tool_calls array — model's move silently lost under concurrent load
body:
## Symptom

On intermittent occasions under concurrent agentic load, a **non-streaming** `/v1/chat/completions` request served with the Gemma4 tool-call parser returns:

- `choices[0].finish_reason == "tool_calls"`
- `choices[0].message.tool_calls == []` (empty array — not null, not missing)
- `choices[0].message.content` empty or a short prose echo

i.e. the engine *signals* that the model made a tool move, but the parsed calls are lost and the raw text is not surfaced either — the model's move is silently swallowed. An agentic client has nothing to execute and nothing to re-parse.

## Environment

- vLLM **0.26.0**, torch 2.11.0+cu130
- Model: `google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct` (compressed-tensors W4A16; also reproduced on the 26B QAT sibling)
- 8× GPU, TP8
- Serve command:

```
vllm serve google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct \
  --served-model-name nexa-small \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser gemma4 --reasoning-parser gemma4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-model-len 131072 \
  --enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --enable-prompt-tokens-details --max-num-batched-tokens 8192
```

## Frequency / conditions

Multi-agent orchestration platform, several concurrent conversations with tool specs (10-40 tools offered per request), long prompts (10k-100k tokens). Roughly **5 occurrences over ~2 days of continuous agentic traffic** (thousands of requests) — rare, but each occurrence breaks the consuming agent's turn (we had to build a client-side typed retry barrier around it).

Client-side capture at the moment of failure (our audit layer): `finish_reason="tool_calls"`, `raw tool_calls=[]`, content head empty/echo. The same request retried immediately usually succeeds, which points at a parser/race condition rather than a prompt problem.

## Possibly related

- #39392 (Gemma4 tool-call-parser produces `<pad>` tokens under concurrent requests) — same parser, also concurrency-correlated, different visible symptom.
- #44522 (closed — parser leaked raw tokens in streaming). Ours is the non-streaming lane: nothing is leaked; the move disappears entirely.

## Expected behavior

When the Gemma4 parser cannot extract any tool call from a completion that triggered the tool-call stop condition, either (a) the raw model text should be preserved in `message.content` so the client can recover, or (b) `finish_reason` should not claim `tool_calls`. `finish_reason=tool_calls` with an empty array and empty content loses the model's output with no recovery path.
